Curve.notes: Code Case explicitly directs use of TM-1 curve tm-1-09. II-D source notes: Groups A-J use the compositions in source Notes 1-7 and 9-11. Source Notes 8 and 9 repeat Group H membership; the curve explicitly references Note 9. Note 5 includes variations of 9Cr-Mo, but only the literal composition is an automatic key. Note 13 names 15Cr-5Ni-3Mo for S15500; this is retained as printed, without correcting it to a database alias. Note 14 limits S45000 data to material aged at 480 degC; manual applicability review is required.
